senses.gloss: to bend over, invert, turn upside down.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 5:5">Tam. V, 5</cite> <he>היה כּוֹפֶה עליהן וכ׳</he> he inverts a large vessel and puts it over them (the coals).

Ib. כּוֹפִין אותה וכ׳ they invert it over &c. Pesik. Ekhah, p. 123ᵃ כ׳ סיח את המנורה the ass (of gold, given as a bribe to the judge) has upset the lamp (offered on the other side; whence a proverbial expression for litigants outbidding each other in bribery); Y. Yoma I, 38ᶜ bot.; Lev. R. s. 21; Pesik. Aḥăré, p. 177ᵃ.—Esp. כ׳ את המיטה to upset the couch, to place the mattresses on or near the floor, as a sign of mourning, opp. to זָקַף.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 15b">M. Kat. 15ᵇ</cite> top [euphemistic version, read with Ms. M.:] <he>דמות … בכם ובעונותיכם … כְּפוּ מיטותיכן וכ׳</he> I (the Lord) had placed my image among you, and for your sins I upset it (decreed death), upset now your beds; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:1:9">Y. Ber. III, 6ᵃ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:5:24">Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᵃ</cite> top <he>כְּפֵה מיטתך</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:5:24">Ib.</cite> <he>כבר כְּפִינוּם</he> we have already lowered them (the couches); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:1:6">Y. Ber. III, 5ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>כפיטם</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Ketubot 4b:6">Keth. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>כּוֹפֶה מיטתו</he> he lowers his couch (when his wife is in mourning); <he>כּוֹפָה מיטתה</he> she lowers &c. (when her husband is in mourning); a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="K00988"><he>כָּפוּי</he></cite>, f. <cite ref="K01115"><he>כְּפוּיָה</he></cite>, pl. <he>כְּפוּיִים</he>, <cite ref="K00990"><he>כְּפוּיוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 12:2">Tosef. Ohol. XII, 2</cite> <he>סאה כ׳ על פיה</he> a dry measure turned upside down. Lam. R. introd. (R. Ḥăn. 3) (play on <he>כפי המלח</he>, v. <cite ref="K00980"><he>כַּף</he></cite>) <he>כְּפוּיֵי מלחמה</he> those upset by war.
Y. Ber. III, 6ᵃ top מטה כ׳ a lowered couch; a. fr.—Esp. כְּפוּי טובה one on whom kindness is upset, ungrateful, unappreciative.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 5a:21">Ab. Zar. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>כפויי טובה בני וכ׳</he> you ungrateful ones, sons of ungrateful ones.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 4">Lev. R. s. 4</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:5">Keth. V, 5</cite> <he>כּוֹפָהּ לעשות וכ׳</he> he may compel her to work in wool.
<cite ref="Yevamot 106a">Yeb. 106ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כּוֹפִין אותו עד וכ׳</he> the court uses means of coercion, until he says ‘I will’, opp. to <he>בעל כרחו</he>.
<cite ref="Sotah 46b:18">Sot. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ ללויה</he> we force a host to escort (protect) his guest on parting.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 12b:11">B. Bath. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>כגון זו כ׳ על מדת סדום</he> in such a case we apply force on the ground of the law of equity (v. <cite ref="O00179"><he>סְדוֹם</he></cite>). Y. Peah I, 15ᵈ; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:7:15">Y. Kidd. I, 61ᶜ</cite> top <he>וכוֹפִין</he> do we compel (a son to support his father)? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:7:15">Ib.</cite> <he>כופין את הבן</he> we do compel &c.—
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 28a:16">R. Hash. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>כְּפָאוֹ ואכל וכ׳</he> if somebody forced him, and he ate Matsah (on the first Passover night).
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 28a:16">Ib.</cite> <he>כ׳ שד</he> a demon possessed him.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 28a:17">Ib.</cite> <he>כְּפָאוּהוּ פרסיים</he> Persians (gentiles) forced him; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Sanhedrin 70b">Snh. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>כפאתו</he>, v. <cite ref="K01061"><he>כָּפַת</he></cite>.]—V. <cite ref="K00334"><he>כּוּף</he></cite> I a. <cite ref="K01043"><he>כָּפַף</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to be inverted, upset; to be forced. Y. M. Kat. l. c. ויִכָּפֶה הסרסור let the agent (of sin, the evil inclination) be overpowered (by mourning ceremonies); Y. Ber. l. c. ויכ׳ כפה (corr. acc.). Ib. 5ᵈ bot.; Y. M. Kat. l. c. אינה נִכְפֵּית need not be upturned, v. דַּרְגֵּשׁ; a. fr.
to be overtaken by a demon, esp. to be epileptic.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26">Lev. R. s. 26</cite> <he>ישראל … שנִכְפּוּ</he> an Israelite and a priest that were afflicted &c.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 112b:14">Pes. 112ᵇ</cite> <he>אותו תינוק נִכְפֶּה</he> that child will become epileptic.
<cite ref="Pesachim 112b:13">Ib.</cite> <he>בנים נִכְפִּין</he> epileptic children; <cite ref="Ketubot 60b:15">Keth. 60ᵇ</cite> (Chald. form) <he>בני נִכְפֵּי</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 4:5">Tosef. B. Bath. IV, 5</cite> <he>נִכְפֵּית היא</he> she is subject to epileptic attacks; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 80a">B. Mets. 80ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 64b:13">Yeb. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>משפחת נִכְפִּין</he> a family subject to epilepsy.
